description.zh:
获取数据的结束时间。使用UTC时间。按照ISO8601标准，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。例如，北京时间2013年01月10日20点00分00秒，表示为`2013-01-10T12:00:00Z`。

如果不是整分，则自动取下一分钟为结束时间点。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. For example, `2013-01-10T12:00:00Z` specifies 20:00:00 (UTC+8) on January 10, 2013.

If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the end time is automatically rounded up to the next minute.

description.zh:
每条监控数据的时间长度。单位：秒。取值：**60**（默认值） 、**300** 、 **900** 或 **3600**。
- 如果（**EndTime**–**StartTime**）/ **Period**小于等于400，可正常返回起始时间点到结束时间点的所有监控数据。
- 如果（**EndTime**–**StartTime**）/ **Period**大于400，无法正常返回监控数据。
description.en:
The duration of each monitoring data entry. Unit: seconds. Valid values: **60** (default), **300**, **900**, and **3600**.

*   If the value of **(EndTime** - **StartTime**)/**Period** is greater than 200, a maximum of 200 monitoring data entries are returned at a time.
*   If the value of (**EndTime** - **StartTime**)/**Period** is less than or equal to 200, only the monitoring data collected between the start time and end time is returned.

description.zh:
EIP所属地域ID。
您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region to which the EIP belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
获取数据的起始时间。使用UTC时间。按照ISO8601标准，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。例如，北京时间2013年01月10日20点00分00秒，表示为`2013-01-10T12:00:00Z`。

如果不是整分，则自动取下一分钟为起始时间点。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. For example, `2013-01-10T12:00:00Z` specifies 20:00:00 (UTC+8) on January 10, 2013.

If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the start time is automatically rounded up to the next minute.

descriptions.zh: 为了提供更好的获取监控数据接口体验，建议您使用云监控（CloudMonitor）提供的统一接口DescribeMetricList查询EIP相关数据。更多信息，请参见[DescribeMetricList](~~51936~~)和[弹性公网IP相关数据](~~162874~~)。
descriptions.en: To improve user experience in querying monitoring data, we recommend that you call the DescribeMetricList API operation provided by CloudMonitor to query EIP monitoring data. For more information, see [DescribeMetricList](~~51936~~) and [EIP monitoring data](~~162874~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-eip-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --allocation-id eip-2zeerraiwb7uj6idcfv0000 --start-time 2020-01-05T01:05:05Z --end-time 2020-01-05T03:05:10Z --period 60 --region cn-hangzhou
